title: Setup Costs and the Financing of Young Firms
eligible_reason: Single common shock date: the Dexia collapse, post = year > 2008 (or date >= 2008Q4) for every county/bank; treated = counties in the top half of Dexia loan share (quart_shareloatreat >= 3) or Dexia-exposed banks (treat08_b). One cohort, triple interactions with high setup cost, time-varying firm controls. Most Dexia results use confidential Banque de France data that are not shipped.
design_notes: Diane part: firm-level cross-sections/panels of young French firms (data_panel_control.dta, a 20% random sample of firms created 2006-2016) for leverage and maturity by setup-cost tercile (Tables 1A, 2, 4, 5B, 9). Dexia DiD: loan-level and county-industry regressions on treated x post x high setup cost with deppost or naf3d/date/department FE and loan controls (Tables 3, 6-8, 10, BdF data via CASD); Table 9 and appendix Tables A4/A10 use Diane data with treated_post_highsuc.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common date (post = year > 2008); triple interaction; time-varying firm controls; department-by-post FE only
specs.code_file: REPLICATION PACKAGE - RESULTS WITH DIANE DATA/REPLICATION - RESULTS WITH DIANE DATA - ALL TABLES.do
specs.reported_location: Tables A4, A10 Panel B (Table 9 similar)

specs.exclusion_reason: single common date; continuous/binary bank exposure x post with loan controls; BdF data not shipped

data_provenance_note: Diane-based regression files are shipped (data_panel_control.dta is the paper's own 20% random sample of new firms, not a subsample drawn for the package). Banque de France credit-register and loan data (SCR, M-Contran, CEFIT) are confidential (CASD) and not shipped; only the county-level treatment file cefit_hhi_shrtreat_2007_tomerge.dta is included.
